text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "the OCOFA has created the legal basis for federal employees to be deployed temporarily for Federal Administration crisis management when necessary (‘Federal Administration personnel pool’)", "gist": "OCOFA established a legal basis for temporary deployment of federal employees for crisis management in the Federal Administration."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "OCOFA", "gist": "Organisation for Crisis Management"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Federal Administration", "gist": "the federal administration"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Federal Administration personnel pool", "gist": "a pool of federal employees available for temporary crisis management deployment"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The Organisation for Crisis Management website provides two online training modules on crisis management in the Federal Administration.", "gist": "The Organisation for Crisis Management website offers two online training modules on crisis management within the Federal Administration."}, {"type": "other", "quote": "Online learning module of the OCOFA Ordinance", "gist": "Link to an online learning module about the OCOFA Ordinance"}, {"type": "other", "quote": "Further informations", "gist": "Link to additional information or documents"}]}
